articles.summary: The rapidly growing regional law firm deployed automated time entry to 225 timekeepers under its SurePoint infrastructure.

articles.summary: Lydecker LLP, a Florida-based law firm with offices across multiple markets, is deploying PointOne across the firm, bringing automated time entry to its 98 timekeepers and eliminating the manual reconstruction of the workday.
articles.title: Lydecker LLP Rolls Out Automated Time Entry Firmwide with PointOne
